description: This Java source file defines the 'DisburseLoanWithoutAutoPaymentHandler' class, which handles commands to disburse loans without automatic down payments. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses services to perform the disbursement operation, handling data integrity exceptions.

classes.name: DisburseLoanWithoutAutoPaymentHandler
classes.description: This class handles loan disbursement commands that do not include auto payment options. It processes commands and manages exceptions related to data integrity issues.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the disbursement of a loan based on the received command and handles potential data integrity exceptions.
